definition.identity: Their sum is baseline-oracle regret here because every oracle is semantic-correct; checked per episode.
definition.ages: All losses here use genuine native candidate timestamps. Semantic-complementary actions can have distinct ages/style, so their residual difference is not missing evidence.
definition.sibling_consistency: Four observed histories differ in cue directions; a shared semantic-correct action set does not require a shared exact MSE minimizer and does not prove a learned causal rule.

bootstrap.status: exploratory component intervals, no confirmatory significance claim
